title: Electronically-releasable suction cup assembly secured to an appliance

features.item: Main body with suction surface on one side
features.quote: The suction cup assembly includes a suction cup secured to the object. The suction cup has a cavity and is configured to be releasably secured to the surface.
features.note: The suction cup acts as the main body with a suction surface to secure an object to a surface.

features.item: First annular sealing unit on the suction surface
features.quote: The base of the suction cup may be fabricated from elastic, flexible material, and includes a flat or curved surface.
features.note: The reference mentions a base of elastic, flexible material that forms the suction cup, which implies a sealing unit, but does not explicitly describe it as an 'annular' sealing unit or distinguish between first and second units.

features.item: Second annular sealing unit on the suction surface, disposed in opening of first annular sealing unit
features.note: The reference does not describe a second annular sealing unit disposed within an opening of a first annular sealing unit.

features.item: First adhering surface on first annular sealing unit, distal from suction surface
features.quote: The base may be configured to be releasably secured to the surface by forming a vacuum with the surface.
features.note: The reference describes the base of the suction cup adhering to a surface, which implies an adhering surface, but does not explicitly define a 'first annular sealing unit' or its 'first adhering surface'.

features.item: Second adhering surface on second annular sealing unit, distal from suction surface
features.note: The reference does not describe a second annular sealing unit or its adhering surface.

features.item: Distance from second adhering surface to suction surface greater than distance from first adhering surface to suction surface
features.note: The reference does not describe two distinct adhering surfaces with different distances from the suction surface.

features.item: Second annular sealing unit, suction surface, and external surface form sealed space when second adhering surface adheres
features.quote: The suction cup has a cavity and is configured to be releasably secured to the surface.
features.note: The reference describes a cavity that forms a vacuum with the surface, which implies a sealed space, but does not explicitly mention a 'second annular sealing unit' as part of its formation.

features.item: Control unit disposed on main body

features.note: The electronic circuit acts as a control unit for the gas generating cell, which is part of the suction cup assembly (main body).

features.item: Vacuum pump disposed on main body, electrically connected to control unit
features.note: The reference describes a gas generating cell to release the suction, but not a vacuum pump to create the suction. It mentions a micro-vacuum pump in one embodiment, but it is not explicitly stated to be electrically connected to a control unit or disposed on the main body in the same way as the gas generating cell.

features.item: Vacuum pump draws air from sealed space to exterior of main body
features.note: The reference does not describe a vacuum pump drawing air from a sealed space to the exterior.

features.quote: For example, a pressure sensor or pressure switch electronically coupled to the electronic circuit 32, can be used to detect the presence or absence of a vacuum in the suction cup's headspace 28.
features.note: The reference explicitly mentions a pressure sensor coupled to the electronic circuit (control unit) to detect vacuum in the suction cup's headspace (sealed space).

features.note: The reference does not describe a vacuum pump or its control by a start button.
